g.title: public.organizations
g.text: A landlord's organisation. RLS org_self (own org, or admin context).

g.title: public.leases
g.text: A tenancy of one unit. One live (pending/active/notice) lease per unit.

g.title: public.payments
g.text: History (void, never delete). Cash, bKash, Nagad, bank, SSLCommerz.

g.title: public.bills
g.text: One bill per lease and month. total = sum of lines, paid = sum of allocations.
